verses.sloka: सुकेशं धार्मिकं दृष्ट्वा वरलब्धं च राक्षसम् ।ग्रामणीर्नाम गन्धर्वो विश्वावसुसमप्रभः ।। ७.५.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: sukeśaṁ dhārmikaṁ dṛṣṭvā varalabdhaṁ ca rākṣasam ।grāmaṇīrnāma gandharvo viśvāvasusamaprabhaḥ ।। 7.5.1 ॥

translations.english: Having seen Sukesha, the righteous demon who had obtained a boon, a Gandharva named Gramani, whose splendor was like that of Vishvavasu, (approached him).

verses.sloka: तस्य देववती नाम द्वितीया श्रीरिवात्मजा ।त्रिषु लोकेषु विख्याता रूपयौवनशालिनी ।तां सुकेशाय धर्मेण ददौ रक्षःश्रियं यथा ।। ७.५.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasya devavatī nāma dvitīyā śrīrivātmajā ।triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātā rūpayauvanaśālinī ।tāṁ sukeśāya dharmeṇa dadau rakṣaḥśriyaṁ yathā ।। 7.5.2 ॥

translations.english: He had a second daughter named Devavati, renowned in the three worlds for her beauty and youth, whom he righteously gave to Sukesha, just as one would bestow the prosperity of the Rakshasas.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने बार बार सिर को दिलाकर और तीन अग्नियों के समान देह धारण किए हुए अगस्त्य जी की ओर निहार कर विस्मित हो उनसे कहा

verses.sloka: वरदानकृतैश्वर्यं सा तं प्राप्य पतिं प्रियम् ।आसीद्देववती तुष्टा धनं प्राप्येव निर्धनः ।। ७.५.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: varadānakṛtaiśvaryaṁ sā taṁ prāpya patiṁ priyam ।āsīddevavatī tuṣṭā dhanaṁ prāpyeva nirdhanaḥ ।। 7.5.3 ॥

translations.english: Having obtained him, her dear husband whose prosperity was due to boons, Devavati became as pleased as a poor man who has acquired wealth.
translations.hindi: हे भगवन्‌ ! पहले भी इस लङ्का पुरो में राक्षस लोग ही बास करते थे, आपका यह्‌ वचन सुन कर म॒कको बड़ा आश्चय्ये हुआ है

verses.sloka: स तया सह संयुक्तो रराज रजनीचरः ।अञ्जनादभिनिष्क्रान्तः करेण्वेव महागजः ।। ७.५.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa tayā saha saṁyukto rarāja rajanīcaraḥ ।añjanādabhiniṣkrāntaḥ kareṇveva mahāgajaḥ ।। 7.5.4 ॥

translations.english: United with her, that Rakshasa shone like a great elephant emerging from the Anjana mountain with a female elephant.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि हमने तो यही सुन रक्खा है कि, पुलस्त्य ही के बंश से राक्षसों की उत्पत्ति हुईं है। परन्त इस समय तम्हारे कथन से, जान पड़ा कि, राक्षसों की उत्पत्ति ( पुलस्त्य के अतिरिक्त ) अन्य किसी से भी हुई है

verses.sloka: देववत्यां सुकेशस्तु जनयामास राघव ।। ७.५.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: devavatyāṁ sukeśastu janayāmāsa rāghava ।। 7.5.5 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, Sukesha begot children in Devavati, O Raghava.
translations.hindi: क्या वे (पहिले के राक्षत) लोग रावण, कुम्भकण, प्रहस्त, 'विकट ओर रावण के पुत्र से भो बढ़ कर बलवान थे

verses.sloka: त्रीन् पुत्रान् जनयामास त्रेताग्निसमविग्रहान् ।माल्यवन्तं सुमालिं च मालिं च बलिनां वरम् ।त्रींस्त्रिनेत्रसमान्पुत्रान्राक्षसान्राक्षसाधिपः ।। ७.५.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: trīn putrān janayāmāsa tretāgnisamavigrahān ।mālyavantaṁ sumāliṁ ca māliṁ ca balināṁ varam ।trīṁstrinetrasamānputrānrākṣasānrākṣasādhipaḥ ।। 7.5.6 ॥

translations.english: The lord of Rakshasas begot three sons, Malyavan, Sumali, and Mali (the best among the strong), who were Rakshasas with bodies like the three sacred fires and equal to Shiva.
translations.hindi: हे ब्रह्मन्‌! उन सब का सूल पूर्वपुरुष कोन महाबलवान था उसका नास कया था ? उन्होंने विष्णु का क्या विगाड़ा था जो उर्न्हाने उन राक्षसां को वहाँ से मार भगाया

verses.sloka: त्रयो लोका इवाव्यग्राः स्थितास्त्रय इवाग्नयः ।त्रयो मन्त्रा इवात्युग्रास्त्रयो घोरा इवामयाः ।। ७.५.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: trayo lokā ivāvyagrāḥ sthitāstraya ivāgnayaḥ ।trayo mantrā ivātyugrāstrayo ghorā ivāmayāḥ ।। 7.5.7 ॥

translations.english: They remained like the three undisturbed worlds, like the three sacred fires, like three extremely fierce incantations, and like three dreadful diseases.
translations.hindi: ह ! यह्‌ समस्त वृत्तांत तुम सुपे विस्तार पूर्वक कहो ओर मेरे इस कुतूहल को उसी तरह दूर करो जिस प्रकार सूय अंधकार को दूर करता है

verses.sloka: त्रयः सुकेशस्य सुतास्त्रेताग्निसमतेजसः ।विवृद्धिमगमंस्तत्र व्याधयोपेक्षिता इव ।। ७.५.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: trayaḥ sukeśasya sutāstretāgnisamatejasaḥ ।vivṛddhimagamaṁstatra vyādhayopekṣitā iva ।। 7.5.8 ॥

translations.english: The three sons of Sukesha, possessing a brilliance akin to the three sacred fires, grew there like neglected diseases.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचंद्र जी के संस्कारित (व्याकरण से शुद्ध) एवं अलङ्कारयुक्त वचन सुनकर, अगस्त्य जी ने कुछ कुछ विस्मित हो श्रीरामचंद्र जी से कहा

verses.sloka: वरप्राप्तिं पितुस्ते तु ज्ञात्वेश्वरतपोबलात् ।तपस्तप्तुं गता मेरुं भ्रातरः कृतनिश्चयाः ।। ७.५.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: varaprāptiṁ pituste tu jñātveśvaratapobalāt ।tapastaptuṁ gatā meruṁ bhrātaraḥ kṛtaniścayāḥ ।। 7.5.9 ॥

translations.english: Having learned of their father's boon obtained through the power of Shiva's penance, the brothers, having made a firm resolve, went to Mount Meru to perform penance.

verses.sloka: प्रगृह्य नियमान्घोरान्राक्षसा नृपसत्तम ।विचेरुस्ते तपो घोरं सर्वभूतभयावहम् ।। ७.५.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: pragṛhya niyamānghorānrākṣasā nṛpasattama ।viceruste tapo ghoraṁ sarvabhūtabhayāvaham ।। 7.5.10 ॥

translations.english: O best of kings, those Rakshasas undertook severe vows and performed terrible penance that instilled fear in all beings.
translations.hindi: वे सब जीव विनीतभाव से सृष्टिकत्ता के पास जा खड़े हुये और बोले कि, हम क्या करें ? उस समय वे सारे भूख ओर प्यास से विकल हो रहे थे

verses.sloka: सत्यार्जवशमोपेतैस्तपोभिरतिदुष्करैः ।सन्तापयन्तस्त्रील्लोँकान्सदेवासुरमानुषान् ।। ७.५.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: satyārjavaśamopetaistapobhiratiduṣkaraiḥ ।santāpayantastrīllom̐kānsadevāsuramānuṣān ।। 7.5.11 ॥

translations.english: Through their extremely difficult penances, which were endowed with truth, straightforwardness, and self-control, they tormented the three worlds, including gods, asuras, and humans.
translations.hindi: प्रजापति ने मुसक्या कर उन सब से कहा कि, हे प्राणियों तुम यल्नपूर्वक मनुष्यों की रक्षा करो

verses.sloka: ततो विभुश्चतुर्वक्त्रो विमानवरमास्थितः ।सुकेशपुत्रानामन्त्र्य वरदो ऽस्मीत्यभाषत ।। ७.५.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato vibhuścaturvaktro vimānavaramāsthitaḥ ।sukeśaputrānāmantrya varado 'smītyabhāṣata ।। 7.5.12 ॥

translations.english: Then, the powerful, four-faced Brahma, seated on his excellent aerial chariot, addressed the sons of Sukesha, declaring, "I am here to grant boons."
translations.hindi: उनमें से कुछ भूखे प्राणियों ने कहा, “रक्षामः” ( अर्थात्‌ हम रक्षा करते हें ) और उनमें से कुछ क्षुधारहित प्राणियों ने कहा, “यक्षामः” अर्थात्‌ हम उत्तरोत्तर वृद्धि करते हैं )

verses.sloka: ब्रह्माणं वरदं ज्ञात्वा सेन्द्रैर्देवगणैर्वृतम् ।ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे वेपमाना इव द्रुमाः ।। ७.५.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇaṁ varadaṁ jñātvā sendrairdevagaṇairvṛtam ।ūcuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve vepamānā iva drumāḥ ।। 7.5.13 ॥

translations.english: Realizing that Brahma, the bestower of boons, was present, surrounded by Indra and hosts of gods, all of them spoke with folded hands, trembling like trees.
translations.hindi: उनका यह कथन सुन ब्रह्मा जी बोले कि, जिन प्राणियों ने कहा था कि, “रक्षामः” (हम रक्षा करते हैं ) वे राक्षस हों ओर जिन्होंने कहा, “यत्षामः” वे यक्ष हों

verses.sloka: तपसाराधितो देव यदि नो दिशसे वरम् ।अजेयाः शत्रुहन्तारस्तथैव चिरजीविनः ।। ७.५.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tapasārādhito deva yadi no diśase varam ।ajeyāḥ śatruhantārastathaiva cirajīvinaḥ ।। 7.5.14 ॥

translations.english: They requested, "O Lord, if you, who have been propitiated by our penance, grant us a boon, let us be unconquerable, destroyers of enemies, and also long-lived."
translations.hindi: सत्वकर्तारं-सुष्टिकर्त्तारं | ( गो० ) #पाठान्तरे-“ प्रजापतिस्तु तान्याह सच्वानि प्रहसन्निव ।? †पाठान्तरे-“सानदन्द्‌ः ।? ee उन राक्षसों में हेति और प्रहेति नामक दो भाई उत्पन्न हुए । वे दोनों भाई मधुकेटभ की तरह शत्रुनाशकारी थे । बे दोनों ही राक्षसों के स्वामी हुए

verses.sloka: प्रभविष्ण्वो भवामेति परस्परमनुव्रताः ।। ७.५.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: prabhaviṣṇvo bhavāmeti parasparamanuvratāḥ ।। 7.5.15 ॥

translations.english: They further requested, "And let us be mighty, always devoted to each other."
translations.hindi: प्रहेति धार्मिक स्वाभाव का होने के कारण तप करने को बन सें चला गया । किन्तु हेति अपना विवाह करने के लिए जड़ा प्रयत्न करने लगा

verses.sloka: एवं भविष्यतीत्युक्त्वा सुकेशतनयान्विभुः ।स ययौ ब्रह्मलोकाय ब्रह्मा ब्राह्मणवत्सलः ।। ७.५.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: evaṁ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā sukeśatanayānvibhuḥ ।sa yayau brahmalokāya brahmā brāhmaṇavatsalaḥ ।। 7.5.16 ॥

translations.english: Having told the sons of Sukesha, "So it shall be," the powerful Brahma, who is affectionate to Brahmins, then returned to his own world.
translations.hindi: उच्चह्टद्य और महाबुद्धिमान्‌ हेति ने स्वयं ही काल के निकट जा और परार्थता कर; काल की बहिन के साथ, जिसका नाम भया था ओर जो महाडरावनी थी, विवाह करवा लिया

verses.sloka: वरं लब्ध्वा तु ते सर्वे राम रात्रिञ्चरास्तदा ।सुरासुरान्प्रबाधन्ते वरदानसुनिर्भयाः ।। ७.५.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: varaṁ labdhvā tu te sarve rāma rātriñcarāstadā ।surāsurānprabādhante varadānasunirbhayāḥ ।। 7.5.17 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, having obtained the boon, all those night-wanderers then became very fearless due to the boon and began to harass both gods and asuras.

verses.sloka: तैर्वध्यमानास्त्रिदशाः सर्षिसङ्घाः सचारणाः ।त्रातारं नाधिगच्छन्ति निरयस्था यथा नराः ।। ७.५.१८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tairvadhyamānāstridaśāḥ sarṣisaṅghāḥ sacāraṇāḥ ।trātāraṁ nādhigacchanti nirayasthā yathā narāḥ ।। 7.5.18 ॥

translations.english: Being tormented by them, the gods, along with groups of sages and Charanas, could not find a protector, just like people suffering in hell.
translations.hindi: महातेजस्वी हेति का पुत्र विद्युत्केश सूये की तरह अत्यन्त तेजस्वी हो जल में उगे हुये, कमल को तरह उत्तरोतर बढ़ने लगा

verses.sloka: अथ ते विश्वकर्माणं शिल्पिनां वरमव्ययम् ।ऊचुः समेत्य संहृष्टा राक्षसा रघुसत्तम ।। ७.५.१९ ॥
verses.transliteration: atha te viśvakarmāṇaṁ śilpināṁ varamavyayam ।ūcuḥ sametya saṁhṛṣṭā rākṣasā raghusattama ।। 7.5.19 ॥

translations.english: O best of Raghu's lineage, then those delighted Rakshasas, having met Vishwakarma, the best and imperishable among artisans, spoke to him.

verses.sloka: ओजस्तेजोबलवतां महतामात्मतेजसा ।गृहकर्ता भवानेव देवानां हृदयेप्सितम् ।। ७.५.२० ॥
verses.transliteration: ojastejobalavatāṁ mahatāmātmatejasā ।gṛhakartā bhavāneva devānāṁ hṛdayepsitam ।। 7.5.20 ॥

translations.english: You alone, by your own splendor, are the cherished house-builder for the great, vigorous, splendid, and powerful gods.
translations.hindi: जब वह राक्षस विद्य॒त्केश जवान हुआ, तब उसके पि हेति ने उसका विवाह कर देना चाहा ॥ १६ सन्ध्यादुहितरंसोथस न्ध्या तुल्यां प्रभावतः । वरयामास पुत्रार्थ हेती राचासपुङ्गवः

verses.sloka: अस्माकमपि तावत्त्वं गृहं कुरु महामते ।हिमवन्तमपाश्रित्य मेरुमन्दरमेव वा ।महेश्वरगृहप्रख्यं गृहं नः क्रियतां महत् ।। ७.५.२१ ॥
verses.transliteration: asmākamapi tāvattvaṁ gṛhaṁ kuru mahāmate ।himavantamapāśritya merumandarameva vā ।maheśvaragṛhaprakhyaṁ gṛhaṁ naḥ kriyatāṁ mahat ।। 7.5.21 ॥

translations.english: O great-minded one, therefore, please build a grand dwelling for us also, resembling the abode of Maheswara, either by resorting to the Himalayas or Mount Meru or Mandara.
translations.hindi: हे राघव ! कन्या तो किसी न किसी को देनी ही है--यह विचार कर संध्या ने दिय्यत्केश को अपनी बेटी दे डाली है

verses.sloka: विश्वकर्मा ततस्तेषां राक्षसानां महाभुजः ।निवासं कथयामास शक्रस्येवामरावतीम् ।। ७.५.२२ ॥
verses.transliteration: viśvakarmā tatasteṣāṁ rākṣasānāṁ mahābhujaḥ ।nivāsaṁ kathayāmāsa śakrasyevāmarāvatīm ।। 7.5.22 ॥

translations.english: Then, the mighty-armed Vishwakarma described to those Rakshasas a dwelling place, which was like Amaravati, the city of Indra.
translations.hindi: संध्या की बेटी को पाकर राक्षस विद्युस्केश उसके साथ उसी प्रकार विहार करने लगा, जिस प्रकार इंद्र अपनी इंद्राणी के.साथ विहार करते हैं

verses.sloka: दक्षिणस्योदधेस्तीरे त्रिकूटो नाम पर्वतः ।सुवेल इति चाप्यन्यो द्वितीयस्तत्र सत्तमाः ।। ७.५.२३ ॥
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇasyodadhestīre trikūṭo nāma parvataḥ ।suvela iti cāpyanyo dvitīyastatra sattamāḥ ।। 7.5.23 ॥

translations.english: O best ones, on the shore of the southern ocean, there is a mountain named Trikuta, and another, a second one, named Suvela.
translations.hindi: Se DECISIS VER 9 चतुर्थ: सगे ९ ३१ हे राम ! विद्युत्केश की पल्ली सालकटंकटा ने थोड़े दिनों वाद अपने पति से वैसे ही गर्भधारण किया जैसे, समुद्र जल से मेघघदाएँ गर्भधारण करती हैं

verses.sloka: शिखरे तस्य शैलस्य मध्यमे ऽम्बुदसन्निभे ।शकुनैरपि दुष्प्रापे टङ्कच्छिन्नचतुर्दिशि ।। ७.५.२४ ॥
verses.transliteration: śikhare tasya śailasya madhyame 'mbudasannibhe ।śakunairapi duṣprāpe ṭaṅkacchinnacaturdiśi ।। 7.5.24 ॥

translations.english: On the middle peak of that mountain, which resembles a cloud, is difficult for even birds to reach, and is carved on all four sides as if by a chisel.
translations.hindi: उस राचासी ने मेघगर्भ के समान एक बालक मन्दराचल पर जाकर वैसे ही जना, जैसे गङ्गा ने अग्नि से धारण किए हुए गर्भ से बालक जना था

verses.sloka: त्रिंशद्योजनक्स्तीर्णा शतयोजनमायता ।स्वर्णप्राकारसंवीता हेमतोरणसंवृता ।। ७.५.२५ ॥
verses.transliteration: triṁśadyojanakstīrṇā śatayojanamāyatā ।svarṇaprākārasaṁvītā hematoraṇasaṁvṛtā ।। 7.5.25 ॥

translations.english: This place is thirty yojanas wide and a hundred yojanas long, surrounded by golden walls and adorned with golden archways.
translations.hindi: उस सद्य-प्रसूत-शिशु को उसी पर्वत पर छोड़ कर, वह संध्या की वेटी सालकटंकटा सम्भोग की इच्छा से पुनः पति के पास जा विहार करने लगी । उधर उसका वह त्यागा हुआ पुत्र मेघ की तरह शब्द' करने लगा

verses.sloka: मया लङ्केति नगरी शक्राज्ञप्तेन निर्मिता ।तस्यां वसत दुर्धर्षा यूयं राक्षसपुङ्गवाः ।। ७.५.२६ ॥
verses.transliteration: mayā laṅketi nagarī śakrājñaptena nirmitā ।tasyāṁ vasata durdharṣā yūyaṁ rākṣasapuṅgavāḥ ।। 7.5.26 ॥

translations.english: This city, named Lanka, was built by me at Indra's command; O invincible and foremost Rakshasas, you should dwell there.
translations.hindi: शरत्कालीन सूय की तरह दींस्िमान त्यागा हुआ वह शिशु मुह में सुट्टी दिए हुए पड़ा धीरे धीरे रोने लगा

verses.sloka: अमरावतीं समासाद्य सेन्द्रा इव दिवौकसः ।लङ्कादुर्गं समासाद्य राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृताः ।। ७.५.२७ ॥
verses.transliteration: amarāvatīṁ samāsādya sendrā iva divaukasaḥ ।laṅkādurgaṁ samāsādya rākṣasairbahubhirvṛtāḥ ।। 7.5.27 ॥

translations.english: Having reached the fortress of Lanka, you will be surrounded by many Rakshasas, just as the gods, led by Indra, dwell in Amaravati.
translations.hindi: A उत्तरकाण्डे उस समय बेल पर सवार शिव और पार्वती आकाशमा से उधर होकर कहीं जा रहे थे । उन्होने जाते जाते उस बालक के रोने का शब्द सुना

verses.sloka: भविष्यथ दुराधर्षाः शत्रूणां शत्रुसूदनाः ।। ७.५.२८ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyatha durādharṣāḥ śatrūṇāṁ śatrusūdanāḥ ।। 7.5.28 ॥

translations.english: You will become invincible and destroyers of your enemies.
translations.hindi: फिर उस रोते हुए राक्षसशिशु को दोनों ने देखा भी और दयावश पार्वती के कहने से त्रिपुरासुर को मारने वाले महादेव जी ने

verses.sloka: विश्वकर्मवचः श्रुत्वा ततस्ते राक्षसोत्तमाः ।सहस्रानुचरा भूत्वा गत्वा तामवसन्पुरीम् ।। ७.५.२९ ॥
verses.transliteration: viśvakarmavacaḥ śrutvā tataste rākṣasottamāḥ ।sahasrānucarā bhūtvā gatvā tāmavasanpurīm ।। 7.5.29 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of Vishwakarma, those foremost Rakshasas then went to that city with thousands of followers and dwelt there.

verses.sloka: दृढप्राकारपरिखां हैमैर्गृहशतैर्वृताम् ।लङ्कामवाप्य ते हृष्टा न्यवसन्रजनीचराः ।। ७.५.३० ॥
verses.transliteration: dṛḍhaprākāraparikhāṁ haimairgṛhaśatairvṛtām ।laṅkāmavāpya te hṛṣṭā nyavasanrajanīcarāḥ ।। 7.5.30 ॥

translations.english: Having obtained Lanka, which was surrounded by strong walls and moats and hundreds of golden houses, those delighted night-wanderers (Rakshasas) took up residence there.

verses.sloka: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु यथाकामं च राघव ।नर्मदा नाम गन्धर्वी बभूव रघुनन्दन ।। ७.५.३१ ॥
verses.transliteration: etasminneva kāle tu yathākāmaṁ ca rāghava ।narmadā nāma gandharvī babhūva raghunandana ।। 7.5.31 ॥

translations.english: O Raghava, O delight of Raghu's lineage, at this very time, a Gandharva woman named Narmada was born as desired.
translations.hindi: रादासियाँ गर्भधारण करते ही बालक जने और वह बालक तुरंत माता के समान उम्र वाला हो जाय

verses.sloka: तस्याः कान्यात्रयं ह्यासीत् धीश्रीकिर्तिसमद्युति ।ज्येष्ठक्रमेण सा तेषां राक्षसानामराक्षसी ।। ७.५.३२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ kānyātrayaṁ hyāsīt dhīśrīkirtisamadyuti ।jyeṣṭhakrameṇa sā teṣāṁ rākṣasānāmarākṣasī ।। 7.5.32 ॥

translations.english: She, who was not a Rākṣasī, indeed had three daughters whose splendor was equal to intellect, prosperity, and fame, and these daughters were for those Rākṣasas in order of their seniority.
translations.hindi: इति चतुर्थः सगः ॥ हे राम सुकेश नामक विद्युस्केश का पुत्र महादेव जी से बरदान पा कर, बड़ा घमण्डी हो गया। वह इस आकाशचारी नग ( विमान ) को और लक्ष्मी को पा तथा उस नगर में बेठ कर, चारों ओर घूमने लगा

verses.sloka: कन्यास्ताः प्रददौ हृष्टा पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाः ।त्रयाणां राक्षसेन्द्राणां तिस्रो गन्धर्वकन्यकाः ।। ७.५.३३ ॥
verses.transliteration: kanyāstāḥ pradadau hṛṣṭā pūrṇacandranibhānanāḥ ।trayāṇāṁ rākṣasendrāṇāṁ tisro gandharvakanyakāḥ ।। 7.5.33 ॥

translations.english: Delighted, she gave those three Gandharva maidens, whose faces resembled the full moon, to the three chiefs of the Rākṣasas.

verses.sloka: दत्ता मात्रा महाभागा नक्षत्रे भगदैवते ।कुतदारास्तु ते राम सुकेशतनयास्तदा ।। ७.५.३४ ॥
verses.transliteration: dattā mātrā mahābhāgā nakṣatre bhagadaivate ।kutadārāstu te rāma sukeśatanayāstadā ।। 7.5.34 ॥

translations.english: O greatly fortunate Rama, those sons of Sukesha then indeed took wives, given by their mother in the constellation presided over by Bhaga.

verses.sloka: चिक्रीडुः सह भार्याभिरप्सरोभिरिवामराः ।ततो माल्यवतो भार्या सुन्दरी नाम सुन्दरी ।। ७.५.३५ ॥
verses.transliteration: cikrīḍuḥ saha bhāryābhirapsarobhirivāmarāḥ ।tato mālyavato bhāryā sundarī nāma sundarī ।। 7.5.35 ॥

translations.english: They sported with their wives like gods with Apsaras; then, Malyavan's wife, named Sundari, who was beautiful...

verses.sloka: स तस्यां जनयामास यदपत्यं निबोध तत् ।वज्रमुष्टिर्विरूपाक्षोदुर्मुखश्चैव राक्षसः ।। ७.५.३६ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa tasyāṁ janayāmāsa yadapatyaṁ nibodha tat ।vajramuṣṭirvirūpākṣodurmukhaścaiva rākṣasaḥ ।। 7.5.36 ॥

translations.english: He begot in her the following offspring: Vajramushti, Virupaksha, and Durmukha, who were Rākṣasas.

verses.sloka: सुप्तघ्नो यज्ञकोपश्च मत्तोन्मत्तौ तथैव च ।अनला चाभवत्कन्या सुन्दर्यां राम सुन्दरी ।। ७.५.३७ ॥
verses.transliteration: suptaghno yajñakopaśca mattonmattau tathaiva ca ।analā cābhavatkanyā sundaryāṁ rāma sundarī ।। 7.5.37 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, from Sundari were born sons named Suptaghna, Yajñakopa, Matta, and Unmatta, and also a beautiful daughter named Anala.

verses.sloka: सुमालिनो ऽपि भार्यासीत्पूर्णचद्रनिभानना ।नाम्ना केतुमती राम प्राणेभ्यो ऽपि गरीयसी ।। ७.५.३८ ॥
verses.transliteration: sumālino 'pi bhāryāsītpūrṇacadranibhānanā ।nāmnā ketumatī rāma prāṇebhyo 'pi garīyasī ।। 7.5.38 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, Sumali also had a wife named Ketumati, whose face was like the full moon and who was dearer to him than his own life.

verses.sloka: सुमाली जनयामास यदपत्यं निशाचरः ।केतुमत्यां महाराज तन्निबोधानुपूर्वशः ।। ७.५.३९ ॥
verses.transliteration: sumālī janayāmāsa yadapatyaṁ niśācaraḥ ।ketumatyāṁ mahārāja tannibodhānupūrvaśaḥ ।। 7.5.39 ॥

translations.english: O great king, now learn in due order about the offspring that the demon Sumali begot through Ketumati.

verses.sloka: प्रहस्तो ऽकम्पनश्चैव विकटः कालकार्मुखः ।धूम्राक्षश्चैव दण्डश्च सुपार्श्वश्च महाबलः ।। ७.५.४० ॥
verses.transliteration: prahasto 'kampanaścaiva vikaṭaḥ kālakārmukhaḥ ।dhūmrākṣaścaiva daṇḍaśca supārśvaśca mahābalaḥ ।। 7.5.40 ॥

translations.english: These sons were Prahasta, Akampana, Vikata, Kalakarmukha, Dhūmrākṣa, Danda, and the mighty Suparshva.

verses.sloka: संह्रादिः प्रघसश्चैव भासकर्णश्च राक्षसः ।राका पुष्पोत्कटा चैव कैकसी च शुचिस्मिता ॥
verses.transliteration: saṁhrādiḥ praghasaścaiva bhāsakarṇaśca rākṣasaḥ ।rākā puṣpotkaṭā caiva kaikasī ca śucismitā ॥

translations.english: The demon's other offspring were Samhradi, Praghasa, Bhasakarna, Raka, Pushpotkata, Kaikasi of the pure smile, and Kumbhinasi, all known as Sumali's progeny.

verses.sloka: कुम्भीनसी च इत्येते सुमालेः प्रसवाः स्मृताः ।। ७.५.४१ ॥
verses.transliteration: kumbhīnasī ca ityete sumāleḥ prasavāḥ smṛtāḥ ।। 7.5.41 ॥

translations.english: Kumbhinasi and others are known as the offspring of Sumali.

verses.sloka: मालेस्तु वसुधा नाम गन्धर्वी रूपशालिनी ।भार्यासीत्पद्मपत्राक्षी स्वक्षी यक्षीवरोपमा ।। ७.५.४२ ॥
verses.transliteration: mālestu vasudhā nāma gandharvī rūpaśālinī ।bhāryāsītpadmapatrākṣī svakṣī yakṣīvaropamā ।। 7.5.42 ॥

translations.english: Mali's wife was a beautiful Gandharva woman named Vasudha, who had eyes like lotus petals and was as splendid as a chief Yakshini.

verses.sloka: सुमालेरनुजस्तस्यां जनयामास यत् प्रभो ।अपत्यं कथ्यमानं तु मया त्वं शृणु राघव ।। ७.५.४३ ॥
verses.transliteration: sumāleranujastasyāṁ janayāmāsa yat prabho ।apatyaṁ kathyamānaṁ tu mayā tvaṁ śṛṇu rāghava ।। 7.5.43 ॥

translations.english: O Lord Raghava, listen to the offspring that Sumali's younger brother begot in her, which I am now relating to you.

verses.sloka: अनिलश्चानलश्चैव हरः सम्पातिरेव च ।एते विभीषणामात्या मालेयास्तु निशाचरः ।। ७.५.४४ ॥
verses.transliteration: anilaścānalaścaiva haraḥ sampātireva ca ।ete vibhīṣaṇāmātyā māleyāstu niśācaraḥ ।। 7.5.44 ॥

translations.english: Anila, Anala, Hara, and Sampati are these sons of Mali, who were night-wanderers and later became ministers of Vibhishana.

verses.sloka: ततस्तु ते राक्षसपुङ्गवास्त्रयो निशाचरैः पुत्रशतैश्च संवृताः ।सुरान्सहेन्द्रानृषिनागयक्षान्बबाधिरे तान्बहुवीर्यदर्पिताः ।। ७.५.४५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tatastu te rākṣasapuṅgavāstrayo niśācaraiḥ putraśataiśca saṁvṛtāḥ ।surānsahendrānṛṣināgayakṣānbabādhire tānbahuvīryadarpitāḥ ।। 7.5.45 ॥

translations.english: Then, those three chief Rakshasas, surrounded by hundreds of their Rakshasa sons, became arrogant with their immense power and tormented the gods along with Indra, as well as the Rishis, Nagas, and Yakshas.

verses.sloka: जगद्भ्रमन्तो ऽनिलवद्दुरासदा रणेषु मृत्युप्रतिमानतेजसः ।वरप्रदानादतिगर्विता भृशं क्रतुक्रियाणां प्रशमङ्कराः सदा ।। ७.५.४६ ।।
verses.transliteration: jagadbhramanto 'nilavaddurāsadā raṇeṣu mṛtyupratimānatejasaḥ ।varapradānādatigarvitā bhṛśaṁ kratukriyāṇāṁ praśamaṅkarāḥ sadā ।। 7.5.46 ।।

translations.english: These beings wander the world like the wind, are difficult to approach, possess valor equal to death in battles, are exceedingly proud due to the boon they received, and always destroy sacrificial rites. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चमः सर्गः ।। 5 ।। Thus ends the fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
